LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction01.label: Xenomir
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction01.description: A post-life civilization that abandoned biology. Their bodies are streams of data, and their consciousness wanders between stars like a virus of light.
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction02.label: Omniverse
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction02.description: A supermind that united countless realities into a single field. In their perception, there is no beginning or end—only the symmetry of infinity.
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction03.label: Sytron
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction03.description: A civilization of pure thought. Each inhabitant is a process in an endless network of self-awareness, forming their own physics.
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction04.label: Enios
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction04.description: Energy organisms capable of altering the structure of space. Their thoughts create radiation, triggering the birth of new stars.
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction05.label: Neurex
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction05.description: A collective of symbiotic neural networks linked by quantum channels. They think as a single mind, but speak with thousands of voices.
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction06.label: Spherion
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction06.description: A society of perfect geometry. Their city-spheres hang outside time, reflecting the order of the cosmos in the form of ideal symmetry.
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction07.label: Astralit
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction07.description: Beings living in the upper layers of interstellar radiation. Their consciousness exists in photon streams, and their bodies are light.
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction08.label: Tessera
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction08.description: A faction that controls multidimensional structures. They fold reality like a complex pattern, changing its form without breaking its essence.
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction09.label: Omnidyn
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction09.description: A self-developing mechanism of harmony. Each of their machines is a living being, and each life is a lived formula.
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction10.label: Hyperis
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction10.description: Beings that transcended the speed of light. For them, past, present, and future are a single moment of existence.
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction11.label: Escalon
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction11.description: A society of infinite development. Their pyramid of perfection never reaches its peak, only continues to grow.
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction12.label: Everos
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction12.description: Guardians of continuous renewal. They live through consciousness resets, each cycle becoming more complex, but never aging.
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction13.label: Nodus
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction13.description: A living node of interuniversal connections. Through them pass thoughts, energies, and fates of other worlds—they are the center of the meta-network of existence.
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction14.label: Virtalis
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction14.description: Masters of simulation, creating layers of reality atop reality. Their worlds are indistinguishable from physical ones and sometimes consume their creators.
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction15.label: Lumex
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction15.description: Beings of concentrated light, forming a civilization of photon streams. They radiate meaning instead of speech.
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction16.label: Spectrum
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction16.description: Multi-spectral forms of consciousness, perceiving existence across all wavelengths. Their art is the vibration of matter and thought.
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction17.label: Trium
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction17.description: A triune consciousness where mind, energy, and will became one. Their structure is perfectly stable and self-sufficient.
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction18.label: Prexis
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction18.description: A philosophy turned into a form of life. They transmute experience into pure thought, erasing the boundaries between spirit and logic.
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction19.label: Synedium
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction19.description: A symphony of thinking energies maintaining balance on a galactic scale. Their essence is expressed through the harmony of motion.
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction20.label: Infimum
LanguageData.DF_UltraFaction20.description: The final stage of intellectual evolution. An infinite consciousness for which the universe itself is a thought, aware of itself.
